review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities * Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, Azure, or Digital Ocean). * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments. * Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis (RCA). * Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems. Technical Requirements: * 4+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure roles. * Strong knowledge of Linux systems administration. Preferred Qualifications:
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing cloud environments, automating infrastructure, improving CI/CD pipelines, and supporting high-availability systems in a software development environment. Technical Requirements: * 4+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure roles. * Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience working in software houses or SaaS environments.
